$comment: DB/domain schema for the finance-tracker re-platform. Current state extracted from backend/models.py at commit 18c3530, plus the v2 delta this re-platform introduces (marked 'v2_change'). The merge gate verifies: (a) migrations produce exactly these columns, (b) TS mirror in frontend/src/types.ts matches ts_mirror shapes, (c) contract tests assert endpoint schemas against api-contracts.json.

storage.table_creation: Base.metadata.create_all() on startup + db.py::run_migrations ADD COLUMN for post-deploy column additions (no migration tool by design)
storage.seed: backend/seed.py idempotent: categories, budgets, settings (financial_month_start_day=24), two standing adjustments (Retained Salary <-> Personal Allowance)

columns.amount: NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL (negative=expense; positive=income or refund)
columns.category_id: INTEGER FK categories.id ON DELETE SET NULL, nullable (NULL when split)
columns.import_hash: STRING NOT NULL UNIQUE (SHA-256 of source|date|amount|description[|extra])
columns.is_refund: BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false (positive amount netting against its expense category)
columns.standing_adjustment_id: INTEGER FK standing_adjustments.id ON DELETE SET NULL nullable

invariants: is_refund=true requires amount>0 and category type in needs/wants/savings
when splits exist, category_id is NULL and aggregates read splits only

columns.transaction_id: INTEGER FK transactions.id ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL
columns.category_id: INTEGER FK categories.id ON DELETE SET NULL nullable
columns.is_refund: v2_change: BOOLEAN NULL — NULL means inherit parent transaction.is_refund (backward compatible); set explicitly when a single part of a split is a refund

invariants: parts sum exactly to parent amount (validated in routers/transactions.py::_apply_splits)
>= 2 parts to be a split; parts share parent's sign; no zero parts
v2: effective_parts (backend/aggregate.py) reads per-part is_refund with parent fallback

columns.name: STRING NOT NULL UNIQUE
columns.amount: NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL positive; materialises +amount income leg / -amount expense leg
columns.income_category_id: INTEGER FK categories.id ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL (must be income type)
columns.expense_category_id: INTEGER FK categories.id ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL (must be needs/wants/savings)
columns.start_month: DATE NOT NULL (1st of first label month; earlier months never materialise)

invariants: future months never materialise; deleting a materialised row = opt-out for that month

columns.pattern: STRING NOT NULL (case-insensitive substring match on description)
columns.category_id: INTEGER FK categories.id ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL
INTEGER FK categories.id ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL
columns.month: DATE nullable (NULL = default template, auto-populated per month)

budgets.notes: income/exclude categories get no budget rows

domain_rules.financial_month: label (Y,M) + start_day -> date range [prev-month start_day .. this-month start_day-1]; start_day=1 means calendar month (backend/financial_month.py)
domain_rules.effective_parts: every aggregate expands a transaction into (category_id, amount, is_refund) parts: splits yield one part per row, unsplit yields the row itself (backend/aggregate.py)
domain_rules.spend_contribution: -amount for expense parts and refund parts (refunds reduce category spend, may go below zero); refunds never count as income
domain_rules.sign_policy: rules/AI only auto-assign sign-compatible categories; user may override via review UI (refund/income/transfer three-way for positives)
domain_rules.net_zero_adjustments: adjustment pairs must sum to exactly zero so left_over is unchanged; standing adjustments are the stored template form

v2_migration_delta.wire_format: monetary fields cross the API as integer cents (see api-contracts.json conventions.money_wire_format_v2); DB columns stay NUMERIC(12,2)

ts_mirror.$comment: frontend/src/types.ts must stay shape-compatible with these; F1 updates it for cents + split is_refund
